{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    n=9
    g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    # place a 2x2 L-ish seed, with one 9 and three 2s, away from edges
    r=rng.randint(1,6); c=rng.randint(1,6)
    cells=[(r,c),(r,c+1),(r+1,c),(r+1,c+1)]
    nine=rng.choice(cells)
    for x,y in cells: g[x][y]=9 if (x,y)==nine else 2
    return g"}
